label: All traffic fatalities
definition: Sum of FATALS in the FARS Accident file (all persons who died within 30 days of a crash on a public trafficway).

label: Pedestrian fatalities
definition: Persons killed (PER_AUX A_PERINJ=1) whose person type is pedestrian (A_PTYPE=3).

label: Bicyclist and other pedalcyclist fatalities
definition: Persons killed (A_PERINJ=1) whose person type is pedalcyclist (A_PTYPE=4).

label: Motorcyclist fatalities
definition: Drivers and passengers killed (A_PTYPE in 1,2; A_PERINJ=1) in vehicles whose VEH_AUX body type is motorcycle (A_BODY=7).

label: Speeding-related fatalities
definition: Sum of FATALS in crashes involving speeding (ACC_AUX A_SPCRA=1).

label: Alcohol-impaired-driving fatalities
definition: NHTSA definition: fatalities in crashes involving a driver with BAC .08 g/dL or higher. Computed as the mean over NHTSA's 10 multiply-imputed highest-driver-BAC values (MIDRVACC A1-A10 >= 8) of the crash's FATALS, which reproduces NHTSA's published 2023 national figure (12,382).

label: Passenger-vehicle occupant fatalities
definition: Drivers and passengers killed (A_PTYPE in 1,2; A_PERINJ=1) in passenger cars and light trucks (A_BODY 1-5).

label: Unrestrained passenger-vehicle occupant fatalities
definition: Passenger-vehicle occupants killed whose restraint use is unrestrained (PER_AUX A_RESTUSE=2).

label: Passenger-vehicle occupant fatalities with unknown restraint use
definition: Passenger-vehicle occupants killed whose restraint use is unknown (A_RESTUSE=3); shown as a data-completeness measure.

label: Fatalities in crashes involving a young driver (15-20)
definition: Sum of FATALS in crashes involving at least one driver aged 15-20 (ACC_AUX A_D15_20=1). Counts everyone killed in those crashes, not only the young driver.

label: Fatalities in crashes involving an older driver (65+)
definition: Sum of FATALS in crashes involving at least one driver aged 65+ (ACC_AUX A_D65PLS=1). Counts everyone killed in those crashes.

label: Rural fatalities
definition: Sum of FATALS where land use is rural (ACC_AUX A_RU=1); VMT rate uses rural VMT.

label: Urban fatalities
definition: Sum of FATALS where land use is urban (A_RU=2); VMT rate uses urban VMT.

label: Fatalities with unknown rural/urban land use
definition: Sum of FATALS where land use is unknown (A_RU=3); data-completeness measure.

label: Roadway-departure fatalities
definition: Sum of FATALS in crashes involving a roadway departure, FHWA definition (ACC_AUX A_RD=1).

label: Intersection-related fatalities
definition: Sum of FATALS in crashes at an intersection (ACC_AUX A_INTSEC=1).

label: Fatalities on Interstates (principal arterial)
definition: Sum of FATALS where roadway function class is Interstate (ACC_AUX A_ROADFC=1); VMT rate uses VM-2 Interstate VMT.

label: Fatalities on other freeways and expressways
definition: A_ROADFC=2 (freeway and expressway, principal arterial); VMT rate uses VM-2 other freeways and expressways VMT.

label: Fatalities on other principal arterials
definition: A_ROADFC=3; VMT rate uses VM-2 other principal arterial VMT.

label: Fatalities on minor arterials
definition: A_ROADFC=4; VMT rate uses VM-2 minor arterial VMT.

label: Fatalities on collectors
definition: A_ROADFC=5; VMT rate uses VM-2 major + minor collector VMT.

label: Fatalities on local roads
definition: A_ROADFC=6; VMT rate uses VM-2 local VMT.

label: Fatalities with unknown function class
definition: A_ROADFC=7 (unknown); data-completeness measure.

label: Minutes from crash to EMS arrival at scene (median)
definition: Median of (EMS arrival time - crash time) over fatal crashes where both times are valid (Accident HOUR/MINUTE, ARR_HOUR/ARR_MIN); wraps past midnight; values of 720+ minutes treated as implausible.

label: Minutes from crash to EMS arrival at hospital (median)
definition: Median of (EMS hospital arrival time - crash time) over fatal crashes where both times are valid (HOSP_HR/HOSP_MN); wraps past midnight; values of 720+ minutes treated as implausible.
